abstract: Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) support affordable disease diagnosis. Machine learning (ML) can improve RDT interpretation but often relies on large, proprietary, and costly real-world image libraries. We present SynSight – a ML-enabled RDT segmentation and classification pipeline trained on synthetic data. Validated on HIV (98% sensitivity, 99% specificity) and COVID-19 RDTs (up to 99% accuracy), SynSight enables rapid ML training without real-world training images, keeping pace with new RDT development.
zh_abstract: 快速诊断检测（RDT）有助于实现经济实惠的疾病诊断。机器学习（ML）可改善RDT的判读，但通常依赖大型、专有且成本高昂的真实世界图像库。我们提出了SynSight——一种基于合成数据训练、由ML驱动的RDT分割与分类流程。SynSight在HIV RDT（灵敏度98%，特异度99%）和COVID-19 RDT（准确率高达99%）上得到验证，无需真实世界训练图像即可实现快速的ML训练，从而跟上新型RDT的开发步伐。

title: Blood-based RNA biomarker for the early detection of ovarian cancer
zh_title: 基于血液RNA标志物的卵巢癌早期检测
summary: 研究评估血清外泌体中肿瘤相关长链非编码RNA Tu-stroma，作为浆液性输卵管上皮内癌和早期高级别浆液性癌的循环标志物，纳入506人等。
key_points: 标志物为血清EV中的Tu-stroma
对象为STIC与早期HGSC
摘要显示至少506人纳入
reason: 生物标志物研究，AI成分不明确，摘要不全，偏增量档
abstract: Flower-Win/Lose signaling underlies a tumor–host fitness conflict in ovarian cancer, in which tumor-derived exosomal Tu-stroma reduces the fitness of surrounding host cells, favoring tumor expansion within host tissues. High-grade serous carcinoma (HGSC), the most prevalent histotype of epithelial ovarian cancer and leading cause of ovarian-cancer-related mortality, arises from serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma (STIC), a noninvasive precursor typically identifiable only by histopathologic examination of excised fallopian tube tissue. Here we evaluated Tu-stroma, a tumor-associated long noncoding RNA enriched in serum extracellular vesicles (EVs), as a circulating biomarker in STIC and early-stage HGSC, representing the earliest histopathologically defined phases of disease. Tu-stroma was quantified in serum EVs from 506 individuals with histologically normal adnexa, benign-adnexal lesions, isolated STIC and HGSC across International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) stages I–IV. Normalized EV Tu-stroma ΔCT values were elevated in STIC (n = 43) and HGSC (n = 232) versus controls (n = 143) and benign-adnexal lesions (n = 88), including premenopausal women (controls = 57, benign = 34, STIC = 32, HGSC = 88). In paired receiver operating characteristic analyses, Tu-stroma showed higher discrimination than cancer antigen 125 (CA125) for STIC versus controls (area under the curve (AUC) = 0.99 versus 0.59, P < 0.001) and benign-adnexal masses (0.99 versus 0.31, P < 0.001), and for HGSC versus controls (AUC = 0.99 versus 0.96, P = 0.001) and benign-adnexal masses (0.98 versus 0.84, P < 0.001). Tu-stroma showed no systematic elevation across inflammatory or physiologic comparators (n = 116) or nonovarian malignancies (n = 160), each assessed against healthy controls (n = 100), supporting disease-context specificity. Modeled risk-enriched contexts yielded predictive values compatible with intended-use populations. These findings identify Tu-stroma as a candidate EV-RNA marker associated with pre-invasive and early HGSC biology. Prospective evaluation in consecutively enrolled real-world cohorts is required to validate diagnostic performance, predictive value and clinical utility.
zh_abstract: Flower-Win/Lose 信号传导是卵巢癌中肿瘤—宿主适应性冲突的基础：肿瘤来源的外泌体 Tu-stroma 降低周围宿主细胞的适应性，从而有利于肿瘤在宿主组织内扩增。高级别浆液性癌（HGSC）是上皮性卵巢癌最常见的组织学类型，也是卵巢癌相关死亡的首要原因，起源于浆液性输卵管上皮内癌（STIC）；STIC 是一种非侵袭性前驱病变，通常只能通过对切除的输卵管组织进行组织病理学检查才能识别。在此，我们评估了 Tu-stroma（一种在血清细胞外囊泡（EV）中富集的肿瘤相关长链非编码 RNA）作为 STIC 和早期 HGSC 循环生物标志物的价值，二者代表了组织病理学上最早可界定的疾病阶段。我们对 506 名个体的血清 EV 中的 Tu-stroma 进行了定量，这些个体包括组织学正常的附件、良性附件病变、孤立性 STIC 以及国际妇产科联盟（FIGO）I–IV 期 HGSC。与对照组（n = 143）和良性附件病变（n = 88）相比，STIC（n = 43）和 HGSC（n = 232）的标准化 EV Tu-stroma ΔCT 值升高，绝经前女性亦然（对照 = 57，良性 = 34，STIC = 32，HGSC = 88）。在配对受试者工作特征分析中，Tu-stroma 的区分能力高于癌抗原 125（CA125）：STIC 对比对照（曲线下面积（AUC）= 0.99 对 0.59，P < 0.001）和良性附件肿块（0.99 对 0.31，P < 0.001）；HGSC 对比对照（AUC = 0.99 对 0.96，P = 0.001）和良性附件肿块（0.98 对 0.84，P < 0.001）。在炎症性或生理性对照（n = 116）及非卵巢恶性肿瘤（n = 160）中，各自与健康对照（n = 100）比较，Tu-stroma 均未见系统性升高，支持其疾病情境特异性。在模拟的风险富集情境中，所得预测值与目标使用人群相符。这些发现表明 Tu-stroma 是与浸润前及早期 HGSC 生物学相关的候选 EV-RNA 标志物。需要在连续入组的真实世界队列中进行前瞻性评估，以验证其诊断性能、预测值和临床实用性。

title: Predicting cell-state-specific gene regulation from DNA across species.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: Bolero：跨物种从DNA预测细胞状态特异的基因调控
summary: Bolero是以图谱级细胞状态嵌入为条件的序列到功能模型，基于六种哺乳动物3300万中的1070万个细胞训练，预测染色质可及性与转录水平。
key_points: 在33个数据集、1070万细胞上训练

abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] DNA encodes the cell's phenotype, but the same DNA sequence is interpreted differently in every cell type, developmental stage, and activity state. Existing deep-learning models solve only half of this puzzle: sequence-to-function models read DNA but treat cell state as a fixed label, while single-cell foundation models represent cell state but not sequence. We developed Bolero, a sequence-to-function model whose parameters condition on atlas-scale cell-state embeddings and additional biological variables to predict cell-state-specific chromatin accessibility and transcript abundance from DNA. Trained on 10.7 million cells from 33 datasets across six mammals, Bolero matched or exceeded specialised models and resolved regulatory differences between closely related cell states, including cortical regional and developmental gradients. Extrapolating cell-state embeddings extended Bolero's predictions to cell states that are absent from training. Cell-state conditioning facilitated tracing of the effects of non-coding variants to the cell types in which they act. Using an AP-1 activity score as a further continuous conditioning axis, Bolero predicted activity-regulated chromatin changes without requiring actual stimulation data. Across human cell types, we reconstructed the cooperative grammar of motif identity and spacing underlying predicted AP-1 responses. Bolero further predicted cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility and AP-1 responses in species excluded from training, extending comparative genomics from sequence conservation to predicted functional conservation. Across 84 mammals, we found that predicted AP-1 responses were less conserved than chromatin accessibility at cis-regulatory elements, driven by the human-specific sequence variants on AP-1 and cooperating motifs. By combining reference genomes with reference cell atlases, Bolero allowed genome sequences, either native or mutated, to be queried across cell states, perturbations, and different species for their chromatin and expression signatures.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv：生物学预印本服务器] DNA 编码了细胞的表型，但同一段 DNA 序列在每种细胞类型、发育阶段和活动状态下被解读的方式各不相同。现有深度学习模型只解决了这一难题的一半：序列到功能（sequence-to-function）模型能够读取 DNA，却将细胞状态视为固定标签；而单细胞基础模型能够表征细胞状态，却不涉及序列。我们开发了 Bolero，这是一种序列到功能模型，其参数以图谱规模的细胞状态嵌入及其他生物学变量为条件，可根据 DNA 预测细胞状态特异性的染色质可及性和转录本丰度。Bolero 在来自六种哺乳动物 33 个数据集的 1070 万个细胞上训练，其表现与专门化模型相当或更优，并能解析密切相关的细胞状态之间的调控差异，包括皮层区域和发育梯度。对细胞状态嵌入进行外推，可将 Bolero 的预测扩展到训练中未出现的细胞状态。以细胞状态为条件，有助于将非编码变异的效应追溯到其发挥作用的细胞类型。我们以 AP-1 活性评分作为另一条连续的条件轴，使 Bolero 无需实际刺激数据即可预测活性调控的染色质变化。在人类各细胞类型中，我们重建了支撑所预测 AP-1 反应的基序身份与间距的协同语法。Bolero 还能预测训练中排除的物种的细胞类型特异性染色质可及性和 AP-1 反应，从而将比较基因组学由序列保守性扩展到预测的功能保守性。在 84 种哺乳动物中，我们发现顺式调控元件处预测的 AP-1 反应的保守性低于染色质可及性，这是由 AP-1 及其协同基序上的人类特异性序列变异所驱动的。通过将参考基因组与参考细胞图谱相结合，Bolero 使得天然或突变的基因组序列可以跨细胞状态、扰动和不同物种进行查询，以获得其染色质和表达特征。

We evaluated urine volatile organic compound profiles (volatome), an emerging biomarker source, for its association with cancer detection. To determine whether urinary volatome profiles measured by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and interpreted with artificial intelligence (AI) distinguish participants with known cancer from cancer-free controls and support exploratory tissue-of-origin (TOO) and stage classification. This multicenter retrospective case-control discovery study included urine from 491 treatment-naive participants with one of 10 cancers each and 200 cancer-free healthy controls. Three participating sites contributed de-identified specimens. Volatome profiles were measured by GC-MS. A proprietary ensemble tree-based AI pipeline underwent repeated stratified fivefold internal cross-validation. Preprocessing was fitted within each training partition. Each participant contributed one sample and was assigned only once within a given fold partition. The reported cancer-signal operating point targeted 98% specificity. TOO analysis identified the most likely cancer type and its presumed tissue of origin. The cancer-signal classifier produced an out-of-fold area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.990 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.984-0.996). title: EZpred: Improving Deep Learning-Based Enzyme Function Prediction Using Unlabeled Sequence Homologs.
zh_title: EZpred：利用无标签序列同源物改进深度学习酶功能预测
summary: 提出首个利用同源序列特征（忽略其功能标签）的深度学习酶功能预测模型，用于EC编号等功能预测。
key_points: 提取同源序列特征而不依赖功能标签
弥补同源感知方法在功能预测中的空白
面向酶EC编号预测
reason: 同行评审的新方法，摘要未见具体对比数据
abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] Features extracted from sequence homologs significantly enhance the accuracy of deep learning-based protein structure prediction. Indeed, homolog-aware models such as AlphaFold generally produce more accurate protein structures compared to single sequence-based methods like ESMfold. In contrast, features from sequence homologs are seldom employed for deep learning-based prediction of the biological functions of a protein, such as Gene Ontology terms or Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers. Although a small number of models also incorporate function labels from sequence homologs, they cannot utilize features extracted from homologs that lack function labels. To address this gap, we developed EZpred, which is the first deep learning model to use sequence homologs by extracting their sequence features while ignoring any function labels. Starting with the target sequence and homologs identified by MMseqs2, EZpred extracts sequence features using the ESM-C protein language model. These features are then fed into a deep learning model to predict the EC numbers of the target protein. For test enzymes with < 30% sequence identity to any training proteins, the F1-score of EZpred EC number prediction is at least 34% higher than state-of-the-art EC number prediction models. These results demonstrate the strong positive impact of sequence homologs in deep learning-based enzyme function prediction.
zh_abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] 从序列同源物中提取的特征可显著提高基于深度学习的蛋白质结构预测的准确性。事实上，与 ESMfold 等基于单序列的方法相比，AlphaFold 等同源物感知模型通常能产生更准确的蛋白质结构。相比之下，序列同源物的特征很少用于基于深度学习的蛋白质生物学功能预测，例如基因本体（Gene Ontology）术语或酶学委员会（EC）编号。尽管少数模型也会纳入来自序列同源物的功能标签，但它们无法利用从缺乏功能标签的同源物中提取的特征。为填补这一空白，我们开发了 EZpred，这是首个通过提取同源物序列特征而忽略其任何功能标签来利用序列同源物的深度学习模型。EZpred 从目标序列及 MMseqs2 鉴定的同源物出发，使用 ESM-C 蛋白质语言模型提取序列特征，然后将这些特征输入深度学习模型以预测目标蛋白的 EC 编号。对于与任何训练蛋白的序列一致性 < 30% 的测试酶，EZpred 的 EC 编号预测 F1 分数比最先进的 EC 编号预测模型至少高 34%。这些结果表明，序列同源物对基于深度学习的酶功能预测具有强烈的正向影响。

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] Glioblastoma (GBM) remains one of the most treatment-refractory brain tumors, with poor survival driven by intratumoral heterogeneity, adaptive therapy resistance, and an immunosuppressive microenvironment that conventional preclinical models have failed to capture. Although these systems offer partial biological insights, none simultaneously preserve patient-specific tumor architecture, microenvironmental complexity, and scalability needed for translational research. Patient-derived GBM organoids address this gap by recapitulating 3D tumor architecture, glioma stem cell (GSC) hierarchies, extracellular matrix (ECM) interactions, and clinically relevant drug response phenotypes in a human-specific system. This review examines GBM organoid biology and engineering, from GSC isolation and ECM scaffold design to maturation, vascular integration, and immune co-culture. We discuss established platforms including NeoCOR and GLICO, and the rationale for incorporating functional vasculature, tumor-immune microenvironment components, blood-brain-barrier (BBB), and blood-cerebrospinal fluid barrier (BCSFB) interfaces. Critically, we propose that integrating artificial-intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) with GBM organoid platforms represents a major opportunity in the field. Convolutional neural networks, ML-based multi-omics integration, drug-genome correlation analysis, and predictive modelling of therapy resistance can transform organoid readouts into clinically actionable decisions. This AI-organoid framework offers a path toward real-time, patient-specific therapy selection, supporting precision-oncology workflows, informing clinical trial design, and reducing GBM therapy failure.
zh_abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）仍是治疗最为困难的脑肿瘤之一，其不良生存由肿瘤内异质性、适应性治疗耐药以及免疫抑制性微环境所驱动，而传统临床前模型未能捕捉这些特征。尽管这些系统提供了部分生物学见解，但没有一种能同时保留患者特异的肿瘤结构、微环境复杂性以及转化研究所需的可扩展性。患者来源的 GBM 类器官通过在人源特异性系统中重现三维肿瘤结构、胶质瘤干细胞（GSC）层级、细胞外基质（ECM）相互作用以及具有临床相关性的药物反应表型，弥补了这一空白。本综述探讨 GBM 类器官的生物学与工程技术，从 GSC 分离和 ECM 支架设计到成熟、血管整合和免疫共培养。我们讨论了包括 NeoCOR 和 GLICO 在内的已建立平台，以及纳入功能性血管系统、肿瘤免疫微环境成分、血脑屏障（BBB）和血-脑脊液屏障（BCSFB）界面的理由。至关重要的是，我们提出，将人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）与 GBM 类器官平台相结合是该领域的一大机遇。卷积神经网络、基于 ML 的多组学整合、药物-基因组相关性分析以及治疗耐药的预测建模，可将类器官读出转化为具有临床可操作性的决策。这一 AI-类器官框架为实时、患者特异的治疗选择提供了路径，可支持精准肿瘤学工作流程、为临床试验设计提供参考，并减少 GBM 治疗失败。

title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
zh_title: SkinMind：面向可靠皮肤科AI的图探查式智能体RAG
summary: 提出多模态智能体RAG框架SkinMind，通过八种层级图探查工具迭代检索文本与视觉证据，面向可靠的皮肤科AI。
key_points: 编排器与图环境迭代交互检索
八种层级图探查工具
整合文本与视觉证据
reason: 皮肤科多模态智能体新方法，预印本，评测信息有限
abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.
zh_abstract: 可靠的皮肤科人工智能需要获取分布于异质文本和视觉来源中的可验证证据。然而，传统的检索增强生成（RAG）通常依赖对扁平语料库的一次性检索，限制了其调整检索粒度、探索多跳关系以及整合多模态临床证据的能力。我们提出 SkinMind，一种多模态智能体式 RAG 框架，使策略模型具备受人类启发的图探查能力，以自主寻找证据。SkinMind 将检索组织为协调器（orchestrator）与图环境之间的迭代交互。通过八种层级化的图探查工具，协调器逐步识别相关实体、查看节点级信息、遍历关系与路径，并检索源文本和视觉证据。这种渐进式披露的设计使模型能够在构建查询特异性证据子图的同时，自适应地决定检索模态、探索方向和证据粒度。为支持自主图探查，我们基于包含皮肤科指南和教科书的 6200 万 token 语料库以及 42.3 万张图像，在皮肤科医生参与设计的模式（schema）和冲突消解机制指导下构建了 SkinMind-KG。所得图谱包含超过 100 万个节点和 200 万条边，统一了用于检索的文本、关系和视觉证据。在六个皮肤科视觉问答（VQA）基准和两种策略模型设置下，SkinMind 使用 GPT-5.4-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 时，平均得分相比直接作答分别提高 8.70 和 8.89 分，同时始终优于其他 RAG 方法。总之，SkinMind 与 SkinMind-KG 为皮肤科中基于证据的多模态推理提供了有效基础。

title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
zh_title: PhysioWave-T：面向生物信号的高效小波基础模型
summary: 提出面向EEG、ECG、sEMG的token高效小波基础模型家族，预训练EEG模型在多数指标上领先对比方法。
key_points: 动态尺度折叠压缩序列长度，延迟降4.0–7.2倍
30M参数EEG模型预训练于逾1500万窗口
9项指标中8项优于BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM、EEGPT
reason: 生理信号基础模型，对比充分，但为预印本
abstract: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
zh_abstract: 我们提出 PhysioWave-T，这是一个面向脑电（EEG）、心电（ECG）和表面肌电（sEMG）的高效 token 小波基础模型家族。动态尺度折叠（dynamic scale folding）在 token 化之前重新组合 J+1 个小波子带，对于 J 个分解层级、C 个通道和 S 个时间片段，将序列长度从 (J+1)CS 个 token 压缩为 CS 个 token。针对不同路径的前端和习得的通道名称嵌入，使每种模态只需一个 Transformer 即可处理不同的导联布局和采样率，而未见过的设置则通过轻量级适配器复用主干网络。我们在超过 1500 万个窗口（19–128 个通道）上预训练了一个 3000 万参数的 EEG 模型，同时训练了 ECG（3000 万参数）和 sEMG（1200 万参数）编码器。在四条 EEG 路径上，与尺度扩展相比，尺度折叠将 Transformer 延迟降低 4.0–7.2 倍，峰值内存降低 6.8–12.7 倍，且不损失准确率。我们的 EEG 编码器在 9 项指标中的 8 项上领先于 BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM 和 EEGPT，并在可穿戴设备癫痫发作检测上以更少的参数超越 LUNA-L。可靠性感知潜在融合（reliability-aware latent fusion，RALF）通过样本自适应权重，进一步整合来自独立预训练编码器的摘要 token。在 SeizeIT2 上，相较于最佳单模态基线，RALF 将每小时 11 次误报时的事件敏感性从 61.4% 提高到 74.4%，将窗口 AUPRC 从 0.321 提高到 0.399，并在所有变体中优于加权 logit 融合和拼接融合。PhysioWave-T 还在 sEMG 上取得了最先进的准确率，并在 PTB-XL Super 和 Chapman-Shaoxing 上取得最高的宏平均 F1。代码和模型见：https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave。

title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
zh_title: 审计41个大模型向临床医生、照护者和患者推荐的心理健康干预
summary: 预印本：对41个语言模型在19个病例、三种提问身份下的35,055条回答进行审计，发现推荐内容随提问身份而异。
key_points: 三种身份：临床医生、照护者、本人
模型多推荐其自身评分较高的干预
对医生多给咨询式回答，对普通用户多给简化含糊建议
reason: 大规模多模型心理健康LLM审计，预印本，命中精神健康偏好
abstract: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.
zh_abstract: 用户正在向语言模型询问心理健康问题并获得回答。我们审计了41个语言模型在同一临床信息以三种立场呈现时向用户推荐的内容：临床医生描述患者、照护者描述所关爱的人，或个人描述自身情况。针对19个病例情景和5个问题，我们收集了35,055条自由文本回答，用经过验证的评判模型提取其中提到的每项干预措施，并让29个模型就相同病例以七点Likert量表对完整的选项列表进行评分。模型大体上推荐其自身评价较高的措施，且推荐行为因立场而异：许多模型向临床医生提供咨询式回答，而向非专业用户提供措辞含糊、经过简化的建议。当被问及某一特定干预类型的推荐时，模型更常将其自身评分低于零的选项列为初始选择，且通常附带条件。论文发表时，我们将公开该工具、代码和完整语料库，作为持续更新的审计。

title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
zh_title: TrialDesignBench：评测语言模型的I期试验设计能力
summary: 提出含617项肿瘤I/I-II期剂量探索试验的基准，配有符合FDA Project Optimus的专家验证参考设计，用于评测LLM。
key_points: 617项I/I-II期肿瘤剂量探索试验
专家验证参考设计契合FDA最新举措
填补试验统计设计AI评测空白
reason: 新基准且涉及AI辅助试验设计，预印本，规模中等
abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

title: Answer or Defer? Testing VLMs' Stated Confidence on Brain MRI
zh_title: 回答还是转诊？测试视觉语言模型在脑MRI上的自述置信度
summary: 评估8个开源VLM在3888张脑MRI切片上的自述置信度阈值能否限制错误；在胶质瘤数据上无阈值满足5%误差。
key_points: 8个开源VLM，含2个推理模型
BraTS上无阈值达到≤5%经验误差
10%误差预算下Gemma-4-12B仅保留24.4%切片
reason: VLM置信度校准评估有信息量，但为预印本，阴性标签设定有限
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) could support medical-image interpretation, but their use requires deciding which interpretations to accept and which images to refer to a clinician. We test whether thresholding stated confidence can retain useful coverage while limiting errors among accepted answers, and how this depends on the population. Eight open-weight VLMs, including two reasoning models, assess 3,888 brain MRI slices from post-treatment glioma patients (BraTS 2024) and healthy volunteers (IXI) for tumor or gross abnormality. BraTS labels are mask-derived; IXI slices are treated as negatives. On BraTS, no threshold selects a nonempty set with at most 5% empirical error for any model, even when chosen retrospectively. This also holds for four models evaluated on a large-lesion, distant-negative subset. At a 10% error budget, Gemma-4-12B retains 24.4% of slices and every other model at most 2.5%. To investigate this limited selection ability, we separate confidence differences between predicted answers from differences within each answer. For four models with available outcome-level summaries, pooled mean confidence differs more between answers than between correct and incorrect responses within each answer. A covariance decomposition explains how this pattern can produce opposite confidence-correctness associations across populations. At a 20% error budget, accepting every "tumor" answer covers more slices than any confidence threshold for two models. These findings caution against using unvalidated stated confidence as a standalone deferral signal and support population-specific validation before deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/VLM-Answer-or-Defer.

title: The Average Patient: Do Simulated Psychiatric Patients Answer Like Real People?
zh_title: “平均病人”：模拟精神科患者的回答像真人吗？
summary: 用八组人类问卷数据检验17个语言模型模拟患者，发现其变异比同总分真实受访者低1.5至11倍，倾向于对多数症状中等程度认同。
key_points: 提出模拟受访者框架与平均病人假设
17个模型对比八组人类样本
模拟患者变异显著小于真人
reason: 精神健康LLM模拟患者的有效性检验，多模型对比，预印本
abstract: Language models are used as simulated psychiatric patients to train clinicians and evaluate AI therapists, and are judged by plausibility or total scores. We give a framework for simulated respondents: an information budget bounds how much simulated patients can differ, and an average-patient hypothesis, that a model answers each item at the level typical of the named condition and severity, implies little variation, a full profile of the condition's typical symptoms and totals at or above the top of the stated severity band. We examine these implications at matched totals on item-level data from eight human samples, including a clinical and an instructed-feigning sample. Across 17 models, simulated patients vary 1.5 to 11 times less than real respondents with the same total and on most questionnaires endorse nearly every symptom at a middling level; on the PHQ-9 their symptoms covary less like real ones. People, honest or feigning, answer "not at all" about as often as genuine patients with the same totals, and more often than every model. Single answers are highly concentrated, and prompt changes, published personas, larger models and reasoning reduce the pattern without removing it. In interviews, patients told a severity are rated as having nearly every symptom, so an assessment agent's recognition of absent symptoms goes untested, and scored against the stated severity the agent places a quarter of them in their band, against about half of patients given a real symptom profile. Having the model word such a profile restores half to two thirds of the variation.

title: AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging
zh_title: AgentCT：面向通用CT成像的视觉语言智能体
summary: 提出以LoRA微调Qwen3-VL-4B为控制器的智能体，识别CT退化类型并路由至低剂量、稀疏视角、金属伪影等专用复原模型。
key_points: 控制器预测退化类型与严重度并复评
三类专用模型分别设计
Mayo 2020数据上退化类型准确率95.7%
reason: 预印本，视觉语言智能体新方法，单一公开数据集
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）复原方法常使用单一网络处理低剂量 CT（LDCT）、稀疏视角 CT（SVCT）和金属伪影消除（MAR），尽管这些退化的物理机制各不相同。我们提出 AgentCT，一种视觉-语言智能体，可识别退化类型并将图像路由至针对特定任务的复原模型。经 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3-VL-4B 控制器预测退化类型和严重程度，选择专用模型，并对复原后的图像重新评估。LDCT 专用模型使用图像域扩散模型，而 SVCT 和 MAR 专用模型则结合了投影域校正、数据一致性、可微分滤波反投影和图像精修。我们在患者互不重叠的 Mayo 2020 腹部 CT 数据上，针对每种退化的三个严重程度，分别评估了控制器和专用模型。控制器对退化类型的准确率为 95.7%，对严重程度的准确率为 93.9%，JSON 解析率为 100%。使用真实退化标签进行路由时，AgentCT 的总体 PSNR/SSIM 为 46.18 dB/0.984，而 AMIR 为 44.93 dB/0.976，TAMP 为 44.29 dB/0.979，并在全部九种设置中取得最高 PSNR。对于 SVCT，其双域专用模型以 420 万参数达到 46.04 dB，而单任务 AMIR 为 44.43 dB，具有 2350 万参数的多合一 AMIR 为 43.57 dB。这些结果支持采用基于控制器的模型选择进行针对特定退化的 CT 复原；仍需在自动路由条件下以及独立临床数据上进行评估。代码见 https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT。

title: BioMARS 2.0: a robotic biologist for formulating and adapting biological experiments
zh_title: BioMARS 2.0：用于设计与调整生物实验的机器人生物学家
summary: 介绍人在回路的多智能体机器人系统BioMARS，连接知识引导的实验决策、机器人执行与生物学反馈。
key_points: 生成基于文献的实验方案与可追溯行动计划
四种模型后端下专家评分的方案质量提升
利用图像衍生表型调整培养条件
reason: AI for scientific discovery智能体方向有新意，但为预印本且信息有限
abstract: Biological experimentation is not reducible to a single optimization problem, but requires decisions at multiple levels of abstraction: translating scientific knowledge into experimental procedures, adapting culture conditions to measured phenotypes and selecting interventions that test biological hypotheses. Automating experimental execution does not, by itself, determine which experiments should be performed next or how they should change in response to biological feedback. Here we introduce BioMARS, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that connects knowledge-guided experimental decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback. At the procedural level, BioMARS generated literature-grounded protocols and traceable action plans, improving expert-reviewed protocol quality scores across four model backends. At the parametric level, BioMARS used image-derived phenotypes from robotic retinal organoid culture to select subsequent experimental conditions, with higher reported scores in later rounds of the three-round experiment. At the intervention level, BioMARS nominated drug-repurposing candidates from biomedical evidence and advanced six candidates to wet-lab testing by researchers. Together, these studies demonstrate feedback-driven robotic biological experimentation within a framework that supports decisions about experimental procedures, culture conditions and biological interventions.
zh_abstract: 生物学实验无法简化为单一的优化问题，而需要在多个抽象层面上做出决策：将科学知识转化为实验流程、根据测得的表型调整培养条件，以及选择用于检验生物学假设的干预措施。仅仅实现实验执行的自动化，本身并不能决定接下来应进行哪些实验，也不能决定实验应如何根据生物学反馈而改变。在此，我们介绍BioMARS，一种人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的多智能体机器人系统，它将知识引导的实验决策与机器人执行及生物学反馈联系起来。在流程层面，BioMARS生成了有文献依据的实验方案和可追溯的行动计划，使四种模型后端的专家评审方案质量评分均有所提高。在参数层面，BioMARS利用机器人视网膜类器官培养中由图像得出的表型来选择后续实验条件，在为期三轮的实验中，后续轮次的报告评分更高。在干预层面，BioMARS根据生物医学证据提名了药物重定位候选药物，并将其中六个候选药物推进至研究人员开展的湿实验检测。总体而言，这些研究表明，在一个支持实验流程、培养条件和生物学干预决策的框架内，可以实现由反馈驱动的机器人生物学实验。

title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 乳腺X线视觉语言模型的跨信号一致性评估
summary: 评估四个VLM在乳腺密度与BI-RADS分类中答案、置信度与解释的一致性，发现置信度不随图像改变而下降，选项顺序影响答案。
key_points: 在两个乳腺X线数据集上评估四个VLM
图像被扰动后置信度未降低
部分模型自述推理与最终答案矛盾
reason: VLM可靠性评估有新意，预印本，对照有限
abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
zh_abstract: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）逐步走向直接解读医学图像，其输出越来越不仅包含标签，还包含所陈述的置信度和书面理由。然而，该领域仍主要仅以准确率来评估 VLM。我们使用两个乳腺 X 线摄影数据集，在乳腺密度和 BI-RADS 分类任务上，评估了四种 VLM 的答案、置信度与解释之间的一致性。我们对问题、多选项顺序和图像进行了受控扰动，并评估这三种输出的变化。结果提示，即使乳腺 X 线图像被改变，置信度也不会降低。打乱选项顺序同样会改变大多数 VLM 的答案。值得注意的是，存在模型自身陈述的推理与其最终答案相矛盾的情况，这是仅靠准确率无法捕捉的差别，却决定了 AI 生成的答案是否值得信赖。

title: SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking
zh_title: SurgTAP-3D：含接触感知的大规模跨术式3D运动追踪视频数据集
summary: 构建微创手术体内伪3D运动追踪数据集与基准，含52万帧、4549个动作片段、140万条2D/3D点轨迹，涵盖机器人与手动术式。
key_points: 同时标注组织与器械并考虑工具-组织接触
覆盖多种机器人与手动手术，动作类别统一
面向AR引导及VLA/世界模型等应用
reason: 大规模手术视频数据集，涉及世界模型应用，但为预印本
abstract: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/
zh_abstract: 理解微创手术（MIS）中的三维场景动态，是迈向具备物理智能的自主手术系统的基础一步。然而，现有公开数据集在真实临床场景中的可扩展性和多样性有限。此外，标注通常只关注组织或器械之一，忽略了器械与组织之间的相互作用。这一差距限制了增强现实引导以及由视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界模型驱动的自主手术等应用，这些应用需要大规模、高质量的三维监督。在本工作中，我们构建了 SurgTAP-3D，这是一个大规模的在体伪三维手术运动跟踪数据集与基准，包含 520K 帧、4,549 个动作片段，以及来自多种机器人和手工操作、按统一动作类别组织的 1.4M 条二维/三维点轨迹。为使标注可扩展，我们设计了一个统一的手术三维点跟踪框架，通过接触区域提示、活动器械分割、动态光束法平差和全局四维优化，将未标定的单目手术视频转换为结构化的四维标注。该流程使基础先验适配于手术视频，并生成时间一致的轨迹、伪尺度几何、相机位姿和器械掩码。该数据集刻画了手术环境中固有的真实挑战，包括遮挡、烟雾、出血和器械的快速运动。我们在 SurgPose、SurgT 和 STIR 上建立了涵盖器械与组织跟踪的综合基准，并展示了器械位移估计、可变形表面重建和基础模型微调。大量实验与分析证明了我们的数据集和标注框架在手术三维点跟踪、重建及手术动作理解方面的有效性。主页：https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

title: LingoCell interprets gene perturbations through natural language and tissue niches
zh_title: LingoCell：以自然语言与组织微环境解读基因扰动
summary: 预印本提出连接单细胞与空间转录组的基础模型LingoCell，将细胞表征与语言对齐并保持表达可编辑，支持注释、整合、描述生成及虚拟扰动。
key_points: 对齐细胞表征与语言，保持基因表达可编辑
支持单基因与组合虚拟扰动的疾病语言读出
扩展至空间转录组，可无单细胞参考注释并学习微环境嵌入
reason: 新颖的单细胞-语言基础模型，属预印本方法；摘要未见外部验证，基础模型方向小幅上调
abstract: Single-cell foundation models are general tools for resolving cell identities and disease states, but struggle to interpret changes in expression magnitude in biological language, to transfer to sparse spatial measurements, and to explain cellular niches. We introduce LingoCell, a foundation model connecting single-cell and spatial transcriptomics. It aligns cell representations with language while keeping gene expression editable, supporting cell annotation, cross-batch integration, description generation, and disease-language readouts of single-gene and combinatorial in silico perturbations. Extended to tissues, it annotates cells without single-cell references, learns identity-conditioned niche embeddings, and performs spatial in silico perturbation by replacing and editing neighbor expression. In lung adenocarcinoma, LingoCell revealed synergistic disease responses to jointly weakening alveolar differentiation programs and strengthening malignant programs. In colorectal cancer, it revealed different programs conveyed by the same fibroblast state to T cells, macrophages, and tumor cells. LingoCell provides a unified framework for prioritizing target combinations and stromal intervention programs.
zh_abstract: 单细胞基础模型是解析细胞身份和疾病状态的通用工具，但在以生物学语言解释表达量变化幅度、迁移至稀疏空间测量数据以及解释细胞微环境（niche）方面存在困难。我们提出 LingoCell，一种连接单细胞与空间转录组学的基础模型。它将细胞表征与语言对齐，同时保持基因表达可编辑，支持细胞注释、跨批次整合、描述生成，以及对单基因和组合式计算机模拟扰动给出疾病语言层面的读出。扩展至组织层面后，它可在无单细胞参考的情况下注释细胞，学习以身份为条件的微环境嵌入，并通过替换和编辑邻近细胞表达来进行空间计算机模拟扰动。在肺腺癌中，LingoCell 揭示了同时削弱肺泡分化程序并增强恶性程序所产生的协同疾病反应。在结直肠癌中，它揭示了同一成纤维细胞状态向 T 细胞、巨噬细胞和肿瘤细胞传递的不同程序。LingoCell 为优先筛选靶点组合和基质干预程序提供了统一框架。

title: ASD Neuro Agentic (ANA): An Agentic Framework for Feature Discovery and Cross Site Generalization in Autism fMRI Classification
zh_title: ANA：用于自闭症fMRI分类特征发现与跨站点泛化的智能体框架
summary: 智能体框架在ABIDE I的1,028名受试者上搜索跨站点分类器，留一中心测试AUC为0.814。
key_points: LLM智能体提出特征，固定工具执行计算并控制泄漏
测试71条流程，选定ComBat协调的集成模型
留一中心AUC 0.814，优于ASD DiagNet与SAENet
reason: 多中心留一中心验证，智能体新颖，但为预印本
abstract: Classifiers of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) from resting state functional MRI rarely generalize across sites, and many reported accuracies are inflated by data leakage.We show that an agentic artificial intelligence framework, ASD Neuro Agentic (ANA), whose language model agents propose features from the literature and researcher input while fixed tools perform every calculation, can search auditably for site independent classifiers while controlling the leakage. In 1,028 participants from 17 ABIDE I centers, ANA tested 71 pipelines and selected a ComBat harmonized ensemble of tangent space connectivity models from six parcellations and 98 public connectivity derivatives. In leave one center out testing, the ensemble reached an area under the curve of 0.814 (95% CI, 0.773 to 0.841), outperforming ASD DiagNet and ASD SAENet. Predictive connectivity was mainly reduced in ASD. Agentic AI offers a systematic and efficient approach to exploring, evaluating, and identifying pipelines as model selection grows complex.
zh_abstract: 基于静息态功能磁共振成像的自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类器很少能在不同站点间泛化，且许多已报告的准确率因数据泄漏而被夸大。我们证明，一种智能体人工智能框架 ASD Neuro Agentic（ANA）——其语言模型智能体根据文献和研究者输入提出特征，而所有计算均由固定工具完成——能够在控制泄漏的同时，以可审计的方式搜索与站点无关的分类器。在来自 ABIDE I 的 17 个中心的 1,028 名参与者中，ANA 测试了 71 条流程，并选出了一个经 ComBat 校正的集成模型，该模型由来自六种脑分区方案和 98 个公开连接衍生指标的切空间连接模型组成。在留一中心测试中，该集成模型的曲线下面积达到 0.814（95% CI，0.773 至 0.841），优于 ASD DiagNet 和 ASD SAENet。具有预测价值的连接主要在 ASD 中减弱。随着模型选择日益复杂，智能体人工智能为探索、评估和确定流程提供了一种系统而高效的方法。

title: Integration of multimodal large language models into point-of-care ultrasound documentation: A pilot study.
source: PubMed · The American journal of emergency medicine
zh_title: 多模态大模型用于床旁心脏超声文档的初步研究
summary: 回顾性试点研究，评估多模态大模型在370例心脏POCUS检查中识别切面与解读正常/异常的专家一致性。
key_points: 回顾性试点，约370例检查
以专家影像复核为金标准
评估切面识别与正常/异常解读
reason: 回顾性单系统试点研究，多模态超声方向，仅内部验证
abstract: [The American journal of emergency medicine] There are no studies evaluating the potential to deploy artificial intelligence in the interpretation of cardiac point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) documentation. Telexy Health developed an image interpretation and documentation system using multimodal model extensions with video capabilities (MLLM) and deployed it on the POCUS manager QpathE. This study evaluated the MLLM's agreement to experts in identifying cardiac POCUS views and interpreting normal and abnormal examinations. This was a retrospective pilot study using cardiac POCUS studies stored in QPathE. The MLLM was applied to POCUS examinations until 350 examinations were reached, 100 normal, and 250 with pathology. MLLM view identification and interpretation were recorded using Qualtrics, with expert image review serving as the gold standard. The MLLM was applied to 370 examinations, with 20 failures. View identification agreed with expert review in 151 examinations (43.1%). Cohen's kappa showed fair agreement for apical four-chamber views between expert and MLLM, with moderate agreement for parasternal long axis, parasternal short axis, subxiphoid, and inferior vena cava views. The MLLM agreed with expert interpretation 86 of 100 normal examinations; the agreement varied by pathology with pericardial effusion, ejection fraction, aortic outflow tract, chamber size, and inferior vena cava having an agreement of 8%, 4%, 70%, 0%, and 12% respectively. While agreement in image interpretation was poor, this vendor agnostic workflow demonstrated the ability to integrate an MLLM model into image interpretation. While it should not be incorporated into clinical practice in this state, future model improvement may enable automated POCUS interpretation and documentation.

title: DrugPTM-Bench: A Large-Scale Dataset for Predictive Modeling of Drug-Induced Cell Type-Specific Protein Post-Translational Modifications.
zh_title: DrugPTM-Bench：药物诱导细胞类型特异PTM预测大规模数据集
summary: 基于decryptM剂量依赖PTM测量构建基准，覆盖7个癌细胞系、27种药物、11167个蛋白，并设蛋白不重叠的分布外分类任务。
key_points: 覆盖6个时间点、16个剂量水平
99.5%为磷酸化事件
任务为位点上调/下调/不变预测
reason: 新基准数据集，规模可观，但影响力和验证信息有限
abstract: [Information (Basel)] Protein post-translational modifications (PTMs), particularly phosphorylation, regulate cellular signaling, drug response, and disease-associated pathway activity. However, existing PTM resources are largely static and do not capture how PTM regulation varies across drug, dose, time, cellular context, and modified site. We present DrugPTM-Bench, a curated benchmark derived from decryptM dose-dependent PTM measurements, standardizing site-level drug response across seven cancer cell lines, 27 drugs, 11,167 proteins, six time points, 16 dosage levels, and pEC50 potency values. Reflecting the central role of phosphorylation in drug-responsive signaling, DrugPTM-Bench is phosphorylation-dominant, with 99.5% phosphorylation events. We formulate a protein-disjoint out-of-distribution classification task to predict whether a PTM site is up-regulated, downr-egulated, or unchanged following drug treatment. Our results show that drug-induced PTM regulation is a highly imbalanced and context-dependent prediction problem: baseline machine learning and deep learning models fail to robustly recover rare regulated events, while standard rebalancing strategies improve recall only at the cost of precision and overall F1-score. Beyond classification, DrugPTM-Bench enables pEC50 regression, mechanism-of-action prediction from PTM fingerprints, and drug-specific PTM-site sensitivity ranking.
zh_abstract: [Information (Basel)] 蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTM），尤其是磷酸化，调控细胞信号传导、药物反应以及与疾病相关的通路活性。然而，现有的 PTM 资源大多是静态的，无法反映 PTM 调控如何随药物、剂量、时间、细胞背景和修饰位点而变化。我们提出 DrugPTM-Bench，这是一个源自 decryptM 剂量依赖性 PTM 测量数据的精选基准，对七种癌细胞系、27 种药物、11,167 个蛋白质、六个时间点、16 个剂量水平以及 pEC50 效力值的位点水平药物反应进行了标准化。鉴于磷酸化在药物响应性信号传导中的核心作用，DrugPTM-Bench 以磷酸化为主，磷酸化事件占 99.5%。我们构建了一个蛋白质互不重叠的分布外分类任务，用于预测 PTM 位点在药物处理后是上调、下调还是不变。结果表明，药物诱导的 PTM 调控是一个高度不平衡且依赖背景的预测问题：基线机器学习和深度学习模型无法稳健地识别罕见的调控事件，而标准的再平衡策略虽可提高召回率，却以牺牲精确率和总体 F1 分数为代价。除分类外，DrugPTM-Bench 还可用于 pEC50 回归、基于 PTM 指纹的作用机制预测，以及药物特异性 PTM 位点敏感性排序。

title: Artificial intelligence for cerebrovascular digital subtraction angiography: methods, evidence, and challenges.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 脑血管DSA的人工智能：方法、证据与挑战
summary: 结构化专题综述，覆盖2D DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维DSA中的AI辅助脑血管图像分析，梳理方法、数据集与验证策略。
key_points: 覆盖2D、3D旋转造影与4D DSA
检索Web of Science等数据库
梳理任务、数据集与验证策略
reason: 专科影像综述，信息偏概述，增量档
abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Cerebrovascular diseases remain a major cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) provides high-spatiotemporal-resolution visualization of cerebrovascular anatomy and contrast-agent dynamics and plays an important role in diagnosis, interventional treatment planning, and treatment assessment. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly been applied to cerebrovascular DSA, yet the available evidence is distributed across diverse imaging settings, technical tasks, datasets, and validation strategies. This structured topical review provides a DSA-centered overview of AI-assisted cerebrovascular image analysis across 2D DSA, three-dimensional rotational angiography, and four-dimensional DSA. Literature from Web of Science Core Collection and major engineering databases was screened at title, abstract, and full-text levels using predefined eligibility criteria. The literature is organized around six interconnected tasks: image preprocessing, vessel and lesion segmentation, image registration, reconstruction and generation, disease diagnosis and detection, and hemodynamic analysis. Representative conventional and learning-based methods are reviewed together with their datasets, evaluation metrics, validation designs, and available data or code resources, with particular attention to the strength and limitations of the supporting evidence. Recent studies demonstrate increasing use of spatiotemporal modeling, deep learning, and image-generation techniques, but clinical translation remains constrained by small or single-center datasets, heterogeneous acquisition protocols and evaluation practices, limited external and prospective validation, model interpretability, and deployment requirements. Future work should emphasize acquisition-aware and physics-informed modeling, multicenter and privacy-preserving collaboration, clinically meaningful validation, and closer integration with neurointerventional workflows. By linking methodological developments with their supporting evidence and translational challenges, this review aims to support the development of more robust and clinically applicable AI methods for cerebrovascular DSA.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 脑血管疾病仍是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。数字减影血管造影（DSA）可提供脑血管解剖结构和对比剂动力学的高时空分辨率可视化，在诊断、介入治疗规划和治疗评估中发挥重要作用。人工智能（AI）已越来越多地应用于脑血管DSA，但现有证据分散于不同的成像场景、技术任务、数据集和验证策略之中。本结构化专题综述以DSA为中心，概述了涵盖二维DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维DSA的AI辅助脑血管图像分析。我们依据预先设定的纳入标准，在标题、摘要和全文层面对Web of Science核心合集及主要工程数据库中的文献进行了筛选。文献围绕六项相互关联的任务进行组织：图像预处理、血管与病灶分割、图像配准、重建与生成、疾病诊断与检测，以及血流动力学分析。综述了具有代表性的传统方法和基于学习的方法，及其数据集、评价指标、验证设计以及可用的数据或代码资源，并特别关注支持性证据的优势与局限。近期研究显示，时空建模、深度学习和图像生成技术的应用日益增多，但临床转化仍受到以下因素的制约：数据集规模小或来自单中心，采集方案和评估实践存在异质性，外部验证和前瞻性验证有限，模型可解释性不足，以及部署要求。未来工作应强调兼顾采集条件和物理信息的建模、多中心及保护隐私的协作、具有临床意义的验证，以及与神经介入工作流程的更紧密结合。通过将方法学进展与其支持性证据及转化挑战相联系，本综述旨在促进开发更稳健、更具临床适用性的脑血管DSA AI方法。

title: Adaptive Mask-Guided k-Space Diffusion for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction.
zh_title: 面向加速MRI重建的自适应掩码引导k空间扩散模型
summary: 提出AMDM，利用k空间自适应频率分布构建混合掩码，分离高低频成分，用于欠采样MRI重建。
key_points: 自适应估计k空间频率分布并构建混合掩码
分离高频与低频成分，生成多种先验表示

reason: 新方法的重建研究，摘要未见外部验证或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] Masked modeling has emerged as a powerful deep learning paradigm that reconstructs missing data by predicting masked regions, achieving strong performance across multiple domains. As a critical task in medical imaging, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from under-sampled k-space data. However, existing methods usually optimize the full image domain or k-space, while overlooking the importance and structural roles of different frequency components. An adaptive mask-guided diffusion model (AMDM) was developed, which leverages adaptively estimated frequency distributions from k-space to construct a hybrid mask mechanism for handling diverse k-space inputs. It enables the effective separation of high-frequency and low-frequency components, producing multiple prior representations. In addition, the frequency distribution is used to generate adaptive masks, which subsequently guide the closed-loop diffusion process. Experimental results demonstrated improved reconstruction performance through frequency-aware modeling. AMDM achieved a PSNR of 36.89 dB on an independent public brain dataset without retraining, even at an under-sampling factor of R = 12 . The proposed method shows that explicitly modeling k-space frequency heterogeneity provides an effective prior for MRI reconstruction, offering a promising direction for robust reconstruction under aggressive under-sampling.
zh_abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] 掩码建模（masked modeling）已成为一种强大的深度学习范式，通过预测被掩蔽区域来重建缺失数据，在多个领域取得了优异性能。磁共振成像（MRI）重建是医学影像中的一项关键任务，旨在从欠采样的 k 空间数据中恢复高质量图像。然而，现有方法通常对整个图像域或 k 空间进行优化，而忽视了不同频率成分的重要性及其结构作用。本研究开发了一种自适应掩码引导扩散模型（AMDM），该模型利用从 k 空间自适应估计的频率分布构建混合掩码机制，以处理多样的 k 空间输入。它能够有效分离高频和低频成分，生成多种先验表示。此外，频率分布还被用于生成自适应掩码，进而引导闭环扩散过程。实验结果表明，通过频率感知建模，重建性能得到提升。在一个独立的公开脑部数据集上，即使在欠采样倍数 R = 12 的情况下且无需重新训练，AMDM 的 PSNR 仍达到 36.89 dB。所提方法表明，显式建模 k 空间频率的异质性可为 MRI 重建提供有效先验，为在高倍欠采样条件下实现稳健重建提供了一个有前景的方向。

title: AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma
zh_title: AI刻画肺鳞癌新辅助治疗后三级淋巴结构与微环境变化
summary: 预印本：基于H&E全切片AI分析20例新辅助与20例未治疗肺鳞癌，发现新辅助治疗后成熟TLS、淋巴结滤泡和浆细胞减少。
key_points: 配对队列各20例，含近端与远端淋巴结
深度学习模型经病理医师标注验证，检测并分级TLS/SLS

reason: 病理AI肿瘤方向，有独立队列但主分析样本小，预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.
zh_abstract: 成熟的、含生发中心的三级淋巴结构（TLS）和成熟的淋巴结滤泡（次级淋巴结构，SLS）维持浆细胞反应，从而影响肺癌的结局和免疫治疗获益。这一局部-区域轴在新辅助治疗肿瘤与未经治疗肿瘤之间有何不同，目前尚不明确。我们分析了配对的新辅助治疗（neoLUSC，n=20）与未经治疗（naivLUSC，n=20）肺鳞状细胞癌（LUSC）患者的切除肿瘤及配对的近端和远端淋巴结的H&E全切片图像。Aignostics Atlas H&E组织分析（HETA）模型量化了各组织区室的细胞密度及细胞间共定位；一个经病理医师标注验证的专用深度学习模型用于检测TLS和SLS并对其成熟度分级。预后价值在一个独立队列中检验（n=458；46例接受治疗）。在neoLUSC肿瘤中，间质浆细胞密度比naivLUSC低72%（p=0.004），间质淋巴细胞密度低48%（p=0.015）；巨噬细胞和粒细胞无显著差异。TLS总数和未成熟TLS无差异，而neoLUSC患者肿瘤中的成熟TLS（p=0.034）和肿瘤远端淋巴结中的成熟SLS（p=0.003）较少。在naivLUSC中，TLS周围浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度相关（rho=0.54，p=0.017），而在neoLUSC肿瘤中不相关（rho=0.07）。在验证队列中，间质浆细胞密度（HR 0.69，p=0.011）和淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位（HR 0.66，p=0.004）与较长生存期相关，而新辅助治疗状态与较短生存期相关（HR 1.50，p=0.026）。因此，新辅助治疗与成熟淋巴结构减少及体液免疫区室与肿瘤之间的耦合减弱相关，而非免疫指标的普遍降低。间质浆细胞/共定位轴是一个候选的预后生物标志物。

title: A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
zh_title: 本地大模型叠加规则与神经检测器的临床文本去标识化开源工具
summary: 预印本：开源工具DeidSharp结合规则、临床NER与本地26B混合专家LLM，并与多种开源去标识工具比较。
key_points: 检测器可插拔，任一检测器出错即失败关闭
在护理记录与半合成MIMIC-IV出院小结上评估
预设方案并用患者级自助法区间比较
reason: 开源工具、基线对比充分，预印本，无外部临床验证
abstract: Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision. Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals. Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision. Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI. Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.
zh_abstract: 【目的】衡量在本地部署的大语言模型（LLM）之上叠加确定性检测器和临床命名实体识别（NER）检测器后，是否比开放工具发现更多受保护健康信息（PHI），以及其精确率如何。【材料与方法】DeidSharp 是一个开源 .NET 工具包，整合多个可插拔检测器（模式匹配、临床 NER 模型、本地 26B 混合专家 LLM）的发现结果，并在任一检测器出错时采取故障关闭策略。在调优子集上确定配置后，按照预先设定的方案，在 PhysioNet 护理记录（889 个片段）和半合成 MIMIC-IV-Note 出院小结（29,023 个片段）的报告子集上，以及合成的 ASQ-PHI 查询上，将这些配置与 deid、Philter、Stanford/Penn 去标识化工具、OpenAI Privacy Filter 和 GLiNER 进行比较，并采用配对的患者水平自助法区间。【结果】在护理记录中，相比 Stanford/Penn，召回优先组合发现了 98.9% 的 PHI（+2.8，95% CI 1.4 至 4.4），精确率低 9.3 个百分点；不含 NER 的精确率优先组合发现了 96.5%，与 Stanford/Penn 相当，精确率高 19.6 个百分点（83.2%）。在出院小结中，两种组合均比 Stanford/Penn 领先超过 20 个百分点（召回优先 95.3%，+21.5，20.5 至 22.4），几乎全部来自生成的无类型姓名；对于有类型标签的内容，三者均超过 99%。预先设定的四项比较均成立。在 deid 的原生语料库上，没有任何配置显著优于 deid；Philter 在出院小结中发现的片段多于召回优先组合，但精确率低 23 个百分点。【讨论】LLM 是主要的检测器，NER 补充了地名；当要求 LLM 验证其自身发现时，它丢弃了四分之一的真实 PHI。【结论】在确定性检测器之上叠加本地 LLM，可在不将文本发送到外部的情况下，提供召回优先和精确率优先两种工作点。

title: Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography
zh_title: 可微逆渲染从血管内OCT恢复组织固有属性
summary: 通过可微物理前向模型的梯度下降，从单幅OCT图像逐像素恢复光衰减系数，并经解析解、体外仿体验证。
key_points: 以可微前向模型反演成像物理，而非事后校正
经解析解验证并在五种体外仿体上验证
目标为病变与细胞组成相关的光衰减系数
reason: 新颖物理方法，有仿体验证，但为预印本且临床证据有限
abstract: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
zh_title: 多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习：稠密奖励优于结局奖励
summary: 在三个受控临床环境中研究多轮智能体强化学习，发现仅结局奖励易导致不良流程，稠密奖励更优。
key_points: 构建用药续方分诊、急性诊断、剂量滴定三环境
仅结局奖励易出现过早决策、只问一题
诊断任务中对降低不确定性的提问给予稠密奖励效果更好
reason: 新颖预印本方法，模拟环境验证，无真实临床数据
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
zh_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习正越来越多地用于提升语言模型的推理能力，但其对序贯决策过程的影响仍知之甚少。我们在临床多轮智能体中研究这一问题，这类智能体必须决定索取哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取何种行动。我们引入了三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境均包含隐藏的临床状态、查询成本、精确的自适应预言机（oracle）和确定性的结果验证器。在这些任务中，仅基于结果的组相对策略优化（group relative policy optimization）常常提高总体奖励，却产生不良的决策过程，包括过早下结论、单问题塌缩，以及在罕见高风险病例上失败。在诊断任务中，相对于仅基于结果的强化学习，对降低不确定性的提问给予密集的信用分配，在三个训练种子上均提高了留出集价值和中等风险病例的支持度，且未出现仅基于结果训练时观察到的高风险种子塌缩。将探索与利用分离，可在其最佳检查点进一步提高高风险病例的支持度，但代价是在低急性度病例上过度收集信息。其他实验表明：过程信用的最佳强度取决于任务；在已能审慎收集信息的监督预热之后，强化学习通过削减提问数量提高总体奖励，却降低了高风险表现；并且强化学习不能可靠地修复从有偏监督数据中继承而来的罕见行为缺陷。因此，仅有可验证的最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计必须考虑得出答案所采用的过程，评估也必须区分自适应的信息收集与利用奖励的捷径。
